explication: The README presents Prism as a stateless payment-connector library: an application uses a unified payment interface, Prism transforms requests for a selected processor, and returns normalized results. This repository also contains broader Hyperswitch server, SDK, and FFI components. The graph emphasizes the documented Prism workflow and shows server and transport components where source-index references support their connections; unsampled connector dispatch details are left unasserted.
